owner_notes: Normal role-separated novel reviews do not claim ATTESTED_ISOLATED assurance.

CHAT_BRIDGED role receipts are structured self-attested execution records. Deterministic guards can verify their artifact/hash/context bindings and internal consistency, but cannot independently attest the model's cognition or prove that all receipts were not authored post hoc in the same session.

Role-separated CHAT_BRIDGED review may satisfy the normal serialization/rebase pipeline only when the applicable per-role evidence contract and blind-first-pass visibility receipt are present; describe the assurance as ROLE_SEPARATED_NOT_ATTESTED_ISOLATED, never as independent execution proof.
Reading/research or a mastery-model declaration does not prove L3/L4. Project L3 requires applied benchmark evidence; L4 requires cross-project repeated external outcome evidence.

Masterwork distillation is a learning capability, not a prose or Canon authority. A successful work is positive and negative evidence at once; no mechanism reaches ACTIVE_RULE merely because it appears in a hit novel.
Only official/authorized or otherwise lawful source access may feed masterwork study. Do not ingest or persist pirated fulltext or repository material that substitutes for the copyrighted original.
An aggregate Acceptance statement is not a substitute for role receipts when the current evidence contract applies.

True execution attestation or chronological provenance requires a distinct execution identity/provider trace or another independently verifiable execution surface; do not simulate that assurance with extra files or role names.

The recovery guard treats the first signing rejection, retry thresholds, second-application readiness gate, mastery model, series master outline, old ARC_001 supersession, full-front-arc rebase state, old-plan supersession and CH9 hold as durable project state; platform presence alone never changes Canon.
CI/regression can verify recovery and enforcement wiring but cannot prove the rewritten packet has better literary quality or signing probability; that remains action-level/live-outcome evidence.
The current-session dispatcher must not claim a specialist executed unless the required capability handshake is AVAILABLE at the required assurance.
Business state remains in GitHub owner main; execution receipts support but do not replace task/checkpoint authority.
